verse: But He said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” Therefore I will boast all the more gladly in my weaknesses, so that the power of Christ may rest on me.
story: Paul begged three times for his thorn to be removed, and God said no, with a reason.
My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness. The thorn stayed, but so did the grace; and the weakness Paul hated became the very place God's power showed clearest.
Your weakness is not disqualifying you. It may be the place His power is about to be seen.
